body: Is it possible to make a map where in order to when, a team would have to break a monument and get a wool back to their base? I think it would be interesting, unique, and fun to build. Thanks

replies.author: toketrain
replies.body:
that sucks :(

on a slightly different topic, but similar enough to use the same post for, would it be possible to have a map in which only one team has a monument and their goal is to defend it as good as possible while another team attacks and tries to break it? it would help people learn to work together to defend in normal dtm maps and would also provide some interesting matches.

the only problem i can see with it is people on the defending side not working together, but that happens in every dtm match where ppl defend anyways.

replies.author: toketrain
replies.body:
yes, there would be a time limit. say, 20/30 minutes. (idk if that's too long/short, just an example)
the team attacking would have to destroy it within the time or they would lose

also, i would write the yml. they would just have to put it in the server. i know how to make it work and add a time limit and such.
